$schema_note: Hand-authored catalog of every CLI flag recognized by MARS/src/RuntimeOptionsParsing.cpp (RuntimeOptions struct, MARS/include/PHAstarPushDemoOptions.h), plus the extra flags specific to phastar_push_replay_sequence.cpp and src/main.cpp (ReloPush-BOSS). Read-only research artifact for a Qt launcher UI; no C++ source was modified to produce this file.

executables.name: phastar_push_demo
executables.description: Primary MARS executable: loads a single-robot ReloPush task sequence (.b64 file) and runs the multi-robot allocation/scheduling search (greedy baseline + LNS or DQN improvement) to produce a coordinated multi-robot execution plan. This is the executable for 'running an instance' of the MARS allocator.

executables.name: phastar_push_replay_sequence
executables.description: Debug/comparison tool: loads the same .b64 sequence as phastar_push_demo, re-executes one explicit task order read back from a task-execution-log CSV (produced by a prior phastar_push_demo run), and shows a side-by-side comparison against the greedy baseline. Accepts every option phastar_push_demo accepts, plus --sequence-csv= and --trial-iteration=.

executables.name: ReloPush-BOSS
executables.description: Single-robot ReloPush pushing-rearrangement planner (Qt GUI app). Reads one line (one problem instance) of a text instance file under input/, plans a single-robot pushing/rearrangement sequence, and writes the result as a .b64 FinalAllocation sequence file under results/relopush-out/ -- this is the file phastar_push_demo's --sequence-file= consumes. Can optionally hand the sequence off to MARS directly over ZeroMQ instead of writing a file (--integrated-mode / --integrated-mars).

env.note: Documented Ubuntu snap-env fix (this repo was moved from a macOS Qt Creator setup to this Ubuntu machine, where the ambient shell/snap environment breaks the Qt binaries): always launch these binaries wrapped exactly as above, with cwd set to the repo root. Note that CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR (used for input/, results/, diagnostics/ paths) is baked into the binary at build time as an absolute path (see include/ReloPush/config.h), so the cwd requirement is about environment/Qt platform plugin stability, not about relative-path resolution.

ReloPush-BOSS.mechanism: Three positional arguments: argv[1]=instance file name (resolved under input/, e.g. 'ReloPush-BOSS_10_objects.txt'), argv[2]=integer line index within that file (each line encodes one problem instance: movable objects, robot pose, goals, assignment), argv[3]=single-character mode. All three must be present and none may start with '-' (checked by has_batch_instance_args in src/main.cpp), otherwise the hardcoded defaults are used: filename='ReloPush-BOSS_12_objects.txt', index=4, mode='f' (note: no ReloPush-BOSS_12_objects.txt exists under input/ currently, so the no-args default instance is not resolvable as-is).

mode_choices.label: ReloPush-F: optimized prerelocation (BOSS), DFS, init guess
Uninformed-Opt: optimized prerelocation, DFS, no init guess
Original: original ReloPush without backtracking (no DFS)

phastar_push_demo.mechanism: --sequence-file=<path> (alias --input-sequence=) points at a prebuilt base64-encoded FinalAllocation sequence file, normally one produced by ReloPush-BOSS under results/relopush-out/. If omitted, falls back to default_sequence_path(), a hardcoded path built from 'ReloPush-BOSS_12_objects.txt' index 10 -- see ambiguity note. Alternatively, --integrated-mode makes it wait on a ZeroMQ socket (--handoff-endpoint=/--mars-endpoint=) for ReloPush-BOSS to hand off a sequence directly, bypassing the file entirely.
phastar_push_demo.ambiguity: default_sequence_path() (MARS/src/RuntimeOptionsParsing.cpp) hardcodes family='ReloPush-BOSS_12_objects.txt', index=10, but no matching .b64 file exists under results/relopush-out/ (only *_8_objects, *_10_objects, *_13_objects families were found -- 100/100/99 files respectively, indices 0..99). Running phastar_push_demo with no --sequence-file= currently fails to load data. The UI should treat --sequence-file= as effectively required, defaulting its dropdown to one of the files that actually exists rather than the compiled-in default.

options.name: Input sequence file (.b64)
options.description: Path to a base64-encoded FinalAllocation sequence file (produced by ReloPush-BOSS) to load as the multi-robot task set. Alias of --input-sequence=; last one wins if both given.

options.name: ReloPush instance file (positional 1)
options.description: argv[1]: instance text file name, resolved under input/. Must be given together with the index and mode positional args (all three, none starting with '-'), else the whole batch-instance code path is skipped and the hardcoded GUI defaults (12_objects.txt, index 4, mode f) are used.

options.name: ReloPush instance line index (positional 2)
options.description: argv[2]: zero-based line index into the instance file; each line is one self-contained problem instance (objects, robot, goals, assignment).

options.name: ReloPush planning mode (positional 3)
options.description: argv[3]: single-character planning mode. f=ReloPush-F (optimized prerelocation, BOSS), d=ReloPush-D (no-opt prerelocation), u=uninformed-opt (optimized prerelocation, no init guess), o=original ReloPush (no backtracking/DFS).

options.name: Number of robots
options.description: Number of MARS robots to allocate tasks across (capped by the predefined MARS robot set). Alias --robot-count= is equivalent.

options.name: Robot boundary mode
options.description: Whether robot-robot / robot-obstacle collision boundary checks use only the robot's origin point (origin) or its full footprint corners (corners). Bare flag --robot-boundary-origin-only is equivalent to =origin.

options.name: Planner expansion threads
options.description: Number of worker threads used for parallel node expansion inside the per-task Hybrid A*/Reed-Shepp transit planner.

options.name: Allocation-improvement method
options.description: Selects the search used to improve on the greedy allocation: lns keeps the destroy/repair Large Neighborhood Search; dqn replaces it with the online Q-learning allocator. Bare flags --lns / --dqn are shorthand.

options.name: Max transit-planner search iterations
options.description: Max Hybrid A*/Reed-Shepp expansion iterations allowed for a single primary transit-planning call.

options.name: Safe-parking max search iterations
options.description: Max search iterations for finding a safe idle-parking pose for a robot. 0 inherits --max-search-iters=.

options.name: Retraction distance (m)
options.description: Distance a robot retracts from an object/contact pose before/after a push maneuver. Alias --retract-distance=.

options.name: Assignment (random reassign) search iterations
options.description: Iterations of the fixed-sequence random-reassignment search over robot-task assignment (0 disables this search method).

options.name: Task-sequence search iterations (both)
options.description: Convenience flag that sets both --local-sequence-search-iters= and --shuffle-sequence-search-iters= to the same value in one shot.

options.name: Local task-sequence search iterations
options.description: Iterations of the local task-order search (swap/relocate edits to the task sequence). 0 disables this search method.

options.name: Full-shuffle task-sequence search iterations
options.description: Iterations of the randomized full-shuffle task-order search. 0 disables this search method.

options.name: LNS iterations
options.description: Number of destroy/repair iterations for the LNS allocation-improvement search (used when --search-mode=lns).

options.name: LNS/DQN batch threads
options.description: Number of scenario evaluations run in parallel per LNS/DQN iteration batch.

options.name: Enable LNS fine-segment retry
options.description: When an LNS candidate plan's transit planning fails, retry with a finer Hybrid A* segment before giving up on that candidate. Disable with --no-lns-fine-segment-retry.

options.name: LNS: preserve task sequence (assignment-only)
options.description: Restrict the LNS destroy/repair search to robot-assignment edits only, preserving the task order (alias --lns-preserve-task-sequence). Default allows sequence edits too; --lns-task-reassign / --no-lns-reassign-only / --lns-allow-sequence-edits restore that default.

options.name: Random seed
options.description: Fixed base RNG seed (unsigned). If omitted, a non-deterministic seed is drawn from std::random_device.

options.name: Early-abort evaluation on task failure
options.description: During allocation search, abort a candidate plan's evaluation as soon as one task fails (saves time on already-infeasible candidates). Does not affect the final best-plan replay. Disable with --no-early-abort.

options.name: Enable learned precedence-order constraints
options.description: Learn and enforce task-precedence constraints across search trials (alias --order-learning). Disable with --disable-order-learning / --no-order-learning.

options.name: Fixed task order (skip search)
options.description: Comma-separated list of 0-based task indices (e.g. '0,1,2,3'), one permutation of all tasks. When set, skips the allocation search entirely and executes exactly this order through the real multi-robot executor, reporting ground-truth makespan/feasibility.

options.name: Safe-parking candidate generation mode
options.description: Strategy used to generate candidate safe-parking poses for a robot: expand (frontier expansion), connected (connectivity-based), vfh (connected + VFH, alias connected-vfh), reverse-recent (retrace robot's recent path, aliases reverse-path/retrace), reverse-recent-shorter (shortened retrace, aliases reverse-recent-refined/reverse-shorter/retrace-shorter, default), random.

options.name: Idle-park on repeated candidate failure
options.description: If a robot repeatedly fails to find a transit/parking candidate, fall back to idle-parking it instead of stalling. Disable with --no-failed-candidate-idle-parking.

options.name: Failed-candidate idle-park threshold
options.description: Number of consecutive initial-transit failures before the failed-candidate idle-parking fallback triggers.

options.name: DQN feature-set version
options.description: Feature-vector version for the DQN allocator. 1=legacy 7-feature set (task-only actions). 2=redesigned 9-dim feature vector with geometric precompute + forward schedule simulation. 3=explicit (task, robot) action space, trimmed 10-dim robot-conditional features. 4=same (task, robot) action space, 12-dim feature vector adding load_imbalance and idle_robot_congestion schedule-state features.

options.name: DQN iterations
options.description: Iteration budget for the online DQN allocation search (used when --search-mode=dqn). Needs ~15-20 warmup iterations before the Q-policy becomes useful.

options.name: DQN learning rate
options.description: Gradient-step learning rate for the cold-start Q-model.

options.name: DQN epsilon (start)
options.description: Epsilon-greedy exploration rate at the start of the DQN run.

options.name: DQN epsilon (end)
options.description: Epsilon-greedy exploration rate at the end of the DQN run (linearly annealed from --dqn-epsilon-start=).

options.name: DQN gradient steps per iteration
options.description: Number of minibatch gradient-descent steps run per DQN search iteration.

options.name: DQN minibatch size
options.description: Minibatch size sampled from the replay buffer for each gradient step.

options.name: DQN hidden units
options.description: 0 = linear Q-model (default). >0 = 1-hidden-layer MLP with this many units.

options.name: DQN exploration reference bias
options.description: v2+ only: fraction of the epsilon-random exploration branch that follows the reference (greedy seed) order's next pick instead of sampling uniformly at random.

options.name: DQN learned-precedence hard-mask threshold
options.description: v2+ only: a learned-precedence edge only hard-masks a candidate once its evidence count reaches this threshold; below it, it only feeds the learned_risk feature.

options.name: DQN scoring mode
options.description: penalty (default): single Q-head regressed onto -makespan/S (feasible) or a fixed infeasibility penalty. decomposed: adds a second binary failure-probability head (f_head); the exploit branch first filters candidates by --dqn-fail-threshold= before taking the Q-argmax. Requires --dqn-features=3 or 4; otherwise silently downgraded back to penalty with a warning.
options.notes: requires dqn_feature_version in {3,4}; auto-downgraded to penalty otherwise

options.name: DQN decomposed-scoring fail threshold
options.description: Decomposed scoring only: a candidate survives the exploit-branch filter iff sigmoid(f_head.predict(phi)) <= this threshold.

options.name: DQN decomposed-scoring positive-class weight
options.description: Decomposed scoring only: positive-class loss weight for f_head's logistic training. 0 = auto (recomputed each call as clamp(#neg/#pos, 1, 10)). >0 = fixed weight.

options.name: DQN relabel-executed corpus mode
options.description: true: recover, per task, the robot that ACTUALLY executed it (vs. the constructed/intended one) and replay/log training transitions against that corrected trajectory. Requires --dqn-features=3 or 4 (no-op otherwise). Can also be given as --dqn-relabel-executed=1/0/true/false.

options.name: DQN freeze model (zero-shot eval)
options.description: Skip every train_model/train_model_logistic call for both q_head and f_head (replay-buffer ingestion and corpus logging still proceed). Intended for evaluating loaded pretrained weights with no further learning.

options.name: DQN pretrained Q-head weights path
options.description: Load pretrained Q-model weights from this path at startup (fine-tune mode); on success, uses the --dqn-finetune-* hyperparameters instead of the cold-start ones for the rest of the run. Empty = cold start.

options.name: DQN pretrained f-head weights path
options.description: Decomposed scoring only: load pretrained failure-probability model (f_head) weights from this path. Empty = f_head starts from fresh random weights.

options.name: DQN fine-tune learning rate
options.description: Learning rate used instead of --dqn-learning-rate= once pretrained weights are loaded via --dqn-init-weights=.

options.name: DQN fine-tune epsilon (start)
options.description: Epsilon-greedy start rate used instead of --dqn-epsilon-start= once pretrained weights are loaded.

options.name: DQN fine-tune epsilon (end)
options.description: Epsilon-greedy end rate used instead of --dqn-epsilon-end= once pretrained weights are loaded.

options.name: DQN transition-log CSV path
options.description: v2+ only: append one CSV row per legal candidate at every construction step to this path (corpus-collection for offline/pretrained study). Empty = disabled.

options.name: Batch-oracle input plans (JSONL)
options.description: Path to a JSONL file (one {"id","order","assign"} object per line); when set, skips search entirely and evaluates every listed plan through the same evaluate_scenario_batch() pathway the DQN/LNS search uses. Requires --eval-plans-out= to also be set.

options.name: Batch-oracle output CSV path
options.description: Output CSV path for --eval-plans=; one row per input line. Required together with --eval-plans=.

options.name: Decision-time step log path (parity check)
options.description: Skip search and dump a DECISION-TIME step-candidate log (all-zero-weight linear model, epsilon=0.0, fully deterministic construction) to this path, for script/pg/parity_check.py. Not compatible with greedy-only mode.

options.name: Geometry export path (JSON)
options.description: Skip search entirely and dump per-instance geometry (task paths, poses, workspace, robots) as JSON to this path.

options.name: Geometry export resample points (k)
options.description: Number of arclength-resampled points per task reference path in the --export-geometry= output.

options.name: Policy-gradient PoC table export path (JSON)
options.description: Skip search (after seed-plan selection) and dump everything script/pg/rollout_sim.py needs to reproduce make_feature_vector_v4 via table lookups: static per-task geometry/DAG, congestion matrices, and precomputed transit_time/parked_blockage tables. Not compatible with greedy-only mode.

options.name: Enable results visualization
options.description: Show the Qt results visualization window after planning (alias --visualization). Disable with --no-visualization.

options.name: Visualize source ReloPush plan
options.description: Show a debug visualization of the loaded single-robot ReloPush plan before running the MARS search (alias --debug-relopush-plan). Disable with --no-visualize-relopush-plan.

options.name: Generate result-summary figure
options.description: Render and save a summary figure of the best plan's robot traces (aliases --visualize-result-summary, --visualize-result-traces). Disable with --no-result-summary-figure. Setting --result-summary-output= also implicitly enables this.

options.name: Result-summary figure output path
options.description: Output path for the result-summary figure image. Setting this also implicitly enables --result-summary-figure.

options.name: Result-summary subplot gap
options.description: Vertical gap (points) between subplots in the result-summary figure.

options.name: Robot trace colors
options.description: Comma-separated list of hex colors (one per robot, cycled if fewer colors than robots) used for per-robot traces in the results window / summary figure.

options.name: Enable low-level debug visualization
options.description: Enable verbose low-level planner debug-visualization drawing (sets the global DEBUG_VIS flag). Disable with --no-debug-vis.

options.name: Enable MARS<->ReloPush integrated handoff
options.description: phastar_push_demo: wait on a ZeroMQ socket (--handoff-endpoint=) for ReloPush-BOSS to hand off a task sequence directly, instead of loading a .b64 file (alias --integrated). ReloPush-BOSS: send its planned sequence to MARS over ZeroMQ instead of writing a .b64 file (alias --integrated-mars, not shared with phastar_push_demo's --integrated).

options.name: MARS<->ReloPush handoff ZeroMQ endpoint
options.description: ZeroMQ endpoint URI used for the --integrated-mode handoff between ReloPush-BOSS and phastar_push_demo. Alias --mars-endpoint=. Must match on both sides.

options.name: Execute plan on real robots
options.description: Dispatch the finalized plan to real robot controllers instead of only simulating/visualizing it (alias --run-on-robot).

options.name: Robot controller port (start)
options.description: Base TCP port for per-robot controller connections; robot i uses port_start + i.

options.name: MPC VESC port (start)
options.description: Base TCP port for per-robot MPC-to-VESC (motor controller) connections.

options.name: MPC localization port (start)
options.description: Base TCP port for per-robot MPC localization-feed connections.

options.name: MPC VESC IP address
options.description: IP address of the VESC (motor controller) interface used by the MPC controller process.

options.name: MPC localization IP address
options.description: IP address of the localization feed used by the MPC controller process.

options.name: Replay: source task-execution-log CSV
options.description: Path to a task-execution-log CSV (as written by phastar_push_demo) to read the object task order from (an 'order' column, or an 'object' column with one row per task).

options.name: Replay: trial iteration to select
options.description: If the source CSV has an 'iteration' column, select the row matching this iteration number. 0 (default) = use the first matching/only row.
options.notes: 0 means 'unset/take first row'; parser floors user input at 1 when explicitly given
